intent: Sweep fixture (MED) for 1s_2br_wd_side_split_bath_hall_ld -- 12x11 m lot, 48 m2 buildable floor (8x6 envelope, buildable depth 6). Published minimum for this topology (its living/dining/kitchen 3-room stack needs buildable depth >= 6; shallower lots route to the gr sibling). Same lot as its briefs/test/ canonical brief. RE-BASED 12x10 -> 12x11 on 2026-08-14: under the 2026-08-05 front setback (2.0 -> 3.0 m) a 12x10 lot yields only 5 m of buildable depth, below the >=6 this topology's LDK stack needs, so the fixture was silently falling back to its _gr sibling and still counting as a sweep PASS — it tested the wrong topology. Its briefs/test/ canonical was rebased at the time; this sweep fixture was missed. The 48 m2 / depth-6 figures quoted above were always the intent and are now true again.
